entities.name: otel-demo/Deployment/ad
entities.reasoning: CPU throttling on ad pods caused high error rate and request failures.
entities.evidence: CPUThrottlingHigh alert on ad pod, RequestErrorRate alert for ad, trace shows ad→flagd 100% error rate

entities.name: otel-demo/Service/ad
entities.reasoning: Service exposed by the failing ad deployment, observed errors.
entities.evidence: RequestErrorRate alert for ad, trace error path

entities.name: otel-demo/Service/flagd
entities.reasoning: Flagd received failing calls from ad, error rate rose to 50%.
entities.evidence: Trace critical path ad→flagd shows error rate jump, RequestErrorRate alert for flagd

entities.name: otel-demo/Service/frontend-proxy
entities.reasoning: Downstream of ad; traffic dropped and error rate increased.
entities.evidence: NoRequestsDetected alert, RequestErrorRate alert, trace shows traffic drop

entities.name: otel-demo/Service/frontend
entities.reasoning: Frontend lost traffic due to upstream proxy failure.

entities.name: otel-demo/Service/recommendation
entities.reasoning: Recommendation service observed 100% error rate in trace path.
entities.evidence: Trace path recommendation→flagd shows error, RequestErrorRate alert

entities.name: otel-demo/Service/fraud-detection
entities.reasoning: Fraud‑detection calls flagd and shows new 100% error rate.
entities.evidence: Trace path fraud-detection→flagd new error, RequestErrorRate alert

entities.name: otel-demo/Service/cart
entities.reasoning: Cart lost traffic as upstream services failed.

entities.name: otel-demo/Service/checkout
entities.reasoning: Checkout lost traffic due to upstream failures.
